title: Create video player page with player, metadata, comments, and related videos

requirements.summary: Update VideoPlayer page to display a large HTML5 video player at the top of the page when a video card is clicked
acceptanceCriteria: Video player is prominently displayed at the top of the page
Player uses HTML5 video element
Video plays when user clicks on a video card from the homepage

file_operations.description: Restructure the page layout to prominently display the HTML5 video player at the top. Use the blob-storage component's ExternalBlob.getDirectURL() method to obtain the streaming video URL for the HTML5 video element. Ensure proper video controls are enabled and the player is responsive. Verify the blob-storage component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Display video title in bold below the video player
acceptanceCriteria: Video title is displayed below the player
Title text is bold
Title matches the video metadata

file_operations.description: Add a bold title display immediately below the video player element. Use the video metadata from the useVideo hook to populate the title. Apply appropriate styling (font-weight-bold or similar) to make the title visually prominent while maintaining the dark theme with red accents.

requirements.summary: Add a Subscribe button next to the channel name below the video player
acceptanceCriteria: Subscribe button appears next to the channel name
Button is visually distinct and clickable
Backend tracks subscription relationships between users and channels
Button shows subscribed state if user is already subscribed

file_operations.description: Add a Subscribe button next to the ChannelNameDisplay component in the video metadata section. Implement click handler that calls a backend subscription method. Show loading state during subscription action. Display 'Subscribe' or 'Subscribed' text based on current subscription status. Use the authorization component to ensure the user is authenticated before allowing subscription. Style the button to be visually distinct with the red accent color when active.

Create a React Query mutation hook for subscribing to channels. Call the backend capability to track subscription relationships. Invalidate subscription status queries on success. Handle authentication requirements using the authorization component. Show toast notifications for success and error states.

Create a React Query hook to fetch the current user's subscription status for a given channel/uploader principal. Return a boolean indicating whether the user is subscribed. Enable the query only when both actor and principal are available.

requirements.summary: Add an expandable description box below the video metadata that can be collapsed and expanded
acceptanceCriteria: Description box is initially collapsed or truncated
User can click to expand the full description
User can collapse the description after expanding
Description content matches video metadata

file_operations.description: Add an expandable description section below the video metadata (title, channel, subscribe button). Initially show only the first 2-3 lines of the description with a 'Show more' button. When clicked, expand to show the full description and change the button to 'Show less'. Use React state to track the expanded/collapsed state. Apply proper text overflow handling for the collapsed state.

requirements.summary: Add a Comments Section at the bottom of the video player page with a text input for 'Add a comment'
acceptanceCriteria: Comments section is positioned at the bottom of the page
Text input field is labeled 'Add a comment'
Existing comments are displayed above the input
New comments appear after submission

file_operations.description: Position the existing CommentSection component at the bottom of the page layout, below the video player and description. Ensure the component receives the videoId prop and is properly integrated into the page structure. The CommentSection component already handles the 'Add a comment' input and comment display functionality.

requirements.summary: Display a list of Related Videos on the right side of the video player in a smaller vertical list format
acceptanceCriteria: Related videos list appears on the right side of the player
Videos are displayed in a vertical list format
Video cards are smaller than the main homepage grid cards
Clicking a related video navigates to that video's player page
List shows at least 5-10 related videos

file_operations.description: Restructure the page layout to use a two-column layout with the main video player and metadata on the left, and a related videos sidebar on the right. Implement simple related videos logic (e.g., same uploader or recent videos from all uploads). Render VideoCard components in a vertical list format with reduced sizing. Ensure clicking a related video navigates to that video's player page using TanStack Router navigation. Make the layout responsive so related videos move below the main content on mobile.

Add an optional 'compact' or 'small' variant prop to VideoCard component that renders a smaller, horizontal layout suitable for the related videos sidebar. Adjust thumbnail size, title truncation, and metadata display to fit the compact format while maintaining readability.
